title: Dave Henry Lodge

services.name: Swift Creek Cabins
services.desc: The location of Swift Creek Cabins is about 15 km north of Dave Henry Lodge. In the trees at the bottom of a gentle basin, these cabins are situated so guests can ski or snowboard open glades to the alpine with lots of big alpine. For serious skiers, this area provides unlimited terrain, some of it steep and challenging. Groups should have advanced snow evaluation skills or a professional skiing guide. There are two cabins here - one set up as kitchen and dining room with propane lamps a cook stove and a wood heater and the other one for sleeping with a wood heater. It will accommodate 6 people comfortably. For exclusive use of Swift Creek Cabins, minimum of 4 people at $80/person/night +

blurb: Summer Spectacular hiking, alpine wildflowers, crystal-clear mountain lakes, and panoramic photo opportunities at every turn. Our cabins are wood-heated: the outhouses are not. Our cozy lodge on the headwaters of Dave Henry Creek is perfect for the wilderness lover who likes a little comfort. Fish for rainbow trout, Hike alpine ridges and meadows or photograph flowers.
